worldcombat.skill.dragonbreath.summary: Take a deep breath and exhale a fan of dragon breath: it fills the whole cone from near to far, catching everyone it sweeps and numbing them, softer at range.
worldcombat.skill.dragonbreath.descripti: The breath deals %1$s special damage, falling off with distance.
It reaches %1$s blocks in front, opens %2$s degrees, and catches up to 8 foes.
A swept target has a %1$s%% chance to be left paralysed; the cone fills over %2$s seconds.
worldcombat.skill.dragonbreath.use.0: Sweep a fan of breath across what is in front
worldcombat.skill.dragonbreath.use.1: Catch a row of foes in one breath
worldcombat.skill.dragonbreath.preferenc: On: the breath opens about 1.25x wider and covers more foes, at the cost of length and single-target power. Off: a focused breath, narrower and longer with more power, but a smaller area and a slightly longer wind-up and cooldown.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of breathing. Larger values breathe first from further away.
On: prefer the breath when two or more foes fit in the cone (may leave a better position to line it up). Off: treat it as an ordinary spell.
With "only unparalysed targets" it skips foes that are already numb, saving this breath for one that can still be numbed.
